observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naiuugnay ang mungkahi sa sanhi; kumpleto ang owner, resources, deadline, sukatan at review; may partner agreement at paliwanag kung paano babaguhin kapag hindi gumana.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Links the proposal to the cause, specifies owner, resources, deadline, measure and review, seeks partner agreement and explains how to revise if it fails.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nangangako ng bagong iskedyul o pondo nang walang pahintulot, o meeting count lamang ang sukatan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Promises a new schedule or funding without agreement, or measures only meetings held.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naiuugnay ang mungkahi sa sanhi; kumpleto ang owner, resources, deadline, sukatan at review; may partner agreement at paliwanag kung paano babaguhin kapag hindi gumana. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Links the proposal to the cause, specifies owner, resources, deadline, measure and review, seeks partner agreement and explains how to revise if it fails. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tumutugon sa sanhi ngunit kulang ang owner o sukatan; ipapunan ang plan card bago muling magpresenta.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Addresses the cause but omits an owner or measure; complete the plan card before presenting again.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nangangako ng bagong iskedyul o pondo nang walang pahintulot, o meeting count lamang ang sukatan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Promises a new schedule or funding without agreement, or measures only meetings held.
